title: Abraham dines with angelic beings

tellings.quote: Abraham encounters a group [clears throat] of angelic beings and he has dinner with them.

plain: The biblical patriarch Abraham met a group of angelic beings at Mamre, in ancient Canaan, and shared a meal with them. The filmmaker and researcher Tim Alberino retells this on the show from the Bible, which he credits in the King James Version of 1611. That version says that at Mamre "three men stood by him" and that, after Abraham had food prepared, "they did eat". It calls them men, and later calls two of them angels when they reach Sodom. In what happens, and in what order, it matches Alberino's account of a meal with beings from beyond.
